title: 5-Day Da Nang Golf, Beach & Nightlife Tour
description: Fast-paced coastal golf and vibrant nightlife. Play Montgomerie Links, Ba Na Hills (under floodlights), and BRG Da Nang (Norman Course).

signatureTour.title: The Coastal Sprint
signatureTour.highlight: A high-energy, fully managed 5-day golf itinerary pairing top Da Nang courses with private craft beer tours and beachfront dining.

inclusions.detail: Dedicated executive transport on standby for all course transfers and evening dining runs.
3 rounds: Montgomerie Links, Ba Na Hills (floodlit/twilight option), and BRG Da Nang (Norman Course).
4 nights in Ocean View Rooms at Chicland Hotel Da Nang on My Khe Beach.
Priority table bookings at premier Da Nang rooftop lounges and craft beer venues.
On-ground assistance managing bag drops, caddie pairings, and evening transit.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Da Nang & My Khe Beach Rooftop Sunset
itinerary.subtitle: Beachfront Welcome
itinerary.imageCaption: Chicland Da Nang Hotel — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Chicland Da Nang Hotel luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Da Nang International Airport where your private driver welcomes your group and transfers you directly to Chicland Hotel Da Nang, overlooking iconic My Khe Beach. Unpack in your Ocean View room and soak in the coastal energy.

Kick off the trip with craft beers and cocktails at Chicland’s rooftop infinity lounge, watching the sun dip behind the Marble Mountains, before an authentic seafood feast along the beachfront promenade.

itinerary.title: Links Strategy at Montgomerie Links & An Thuong Nightlife
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Strategic Links Golf
itinerary.imageCaption: Montgomerie Links Vietnam — Colin Montgomerie (Par 72, 7,091 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Montgomerie Links Vietnam championship golf course Colin Montgomerie Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Montgomerie Links Vietnam. Colin Montgomerie’s 7,090-yard links layout challenges your iron play with tight landing corridors and sculpted green complexes.

Head back to My Khe Beach for a relaxed afternoon on the sand. In the evening, explore the vibrant An Thuong nightlife quarter, enjoying craft cocktails, live music, and excellent international dining.

itinerary.title: Twilight & Floodlit Golf at Ba Na Hills Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Floodlit Mountain Golf
itinerary.imageCaption: Ba Na Hills Golf Club — Luke Donald / IMG (Par 72, 7,858 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Ba Na Hills Golf Club championship golf course Luke Donald / IMG Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Sleep in or hit the beach in the morning before heading to Ba Na Hills Golf Club for an afternoon round that transitions under full stadium floodlights. Luke Donald’s mountain layout becomes truly dramatic as evening falls over the Truong Son peaks.

Post-round beers in the clubhouse are followed by an executive transfer back to Da Nang for late-night craft beer tastings along the Han River.

itinerary.title: Classic Dunes Golf at BRG Da Nang (Norman Course)
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Greg Norman Dunes Masterpiece
itinerary.imageCaption: BRG Da Nang Norman Course — Greg Norman (Par 72, 7,160 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: BRG Da Nang Norman Course championship golf course Greg Norman Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle the original Greg Norman Dunes Course at BRG Da Nang Golf Resort. Wide, rumpled fairways, expansive waste bunkers, and firm conditions make this classic Aussie-style sandbelt test a favorite among golf purists.

Celebrate the final round with a tour-ending dinner and drinks at Da Nang’s premier skyline cocktail lounge, enjoying panoramic views of the Dragon Bridge and sparkling coastline.

itinerary.title: Morning Beach Walk & Airport Departure
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Chicland Da Nang Hotel — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Chicland Da Nang Hotel luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and a final morning stroll along the sands of My Khe Beach before checking out.

Your private executive transfer transports your party and all golf bags to Da Nang International Airport for your journey home.

faqs.question: What time does the floodlit golf start at Ba Na Hills?
faqs.answer: The floodlit system covers all 18 holes, allowing tee times as late as 4:30 PM for a stunning evening golf experience.
